design_philosophy.core: A premium, magical, and institutional educational dashboard. It blends the gravitas of a classic library (dark green, gold, serif fonts) with the modern functionality of a glassmorphism dashboard.
design_philosophy.vibe: Intellectual, cinematic, moody, expensive, and clear.
design_philosophy.contrast: High contrast between the deep dark background and the glowing golden accents.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-cinzel text-[#c9a227]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. gap-8 to gap-12 between major sections. p-8 inside cards.

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#020b04]/80 border-b border-[#c9a227]/20
header.nav_links: font-dm-sans text-sm tracking-wide text-[#f4f1e1] hover:text-[#c9a227] transition-colors

hero.background_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#020b04]/60 via-[#051a09]/80 to-[#020b04]
hero.content_alignment: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center max-w-4xl mx-auto pt-32 pb-20
hero.cta_button: px-8 py-4 bg-[#c9a227] text-[#020b04] font-dm-sans font-bold rounded-sm hover:bg-[#b08d22] transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(201,162,39,0.3)]

glass_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-[#ffffff]/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#c9a227]/15 p-6 hover:border-[#c9a227]/40 transition-all duration-300

modal_hierarchical.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#020b04]/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4
modal_hierarchical.container: w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#051a09] border border-[#c9a227]/30 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]
modal_hierarchical.breadcrumb: flex items-center gap-2 font-dm-sans text-sm text-[#c9a227] mb-6

subject_item.container: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-[#ffffff]/[0.03] border border-white/5
subject_item.icon_wrapper: w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#c9a227]/10 flex items-center justify-center text-[#c9a227]
subject_item.input: flex-1 bg-black/40 border border-[#c9a227]/20 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm font-dm-sans text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#c9a227] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#c9a227]
subject_item.save_button: px-4 py-2 bg-transparent border border-[#c9a227] text-[#c9a227] rounded text-sm font-dm-sans hover:bg-[#c9a227] hover:text-[#020b04] transition-colors
subject_item.go_button: px-4 py-2 bg-[#c9a227] text-[#020b04] rounded text-sm font-dm-sans font-bold hover:bg-[#b08d22] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2

animations.page_load: Fade in and slight upward translation (Framer Motion: initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0})
animations.modal_enter: Scale up slightly and fade in (Framer Motion: initial={opacity: 0, scale: 0.95} animate={opacity: 1, scale: 1})
animations.micro_interactions: Smooth 200ms ease transitions on all hover states (buttons, cards, links).

hero_background.description: Grand library with staircase and dark ambient lighting
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark gradient overlay

abstract_gold_texture.description: Textured abstract dark green and gold waves
abstract_gold_texture.usage: Subtle background element or modal background overlay (highly transparent)
